{{Quote|Be careful there. They don't like visitors unless you're an Imperial. Better than being a Nyax follower! Eh. May as well be the same thing.|[[Lock Vlash]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LV">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Lock Vlash|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Stronghold''' was a military base used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
Located in the [[Suntir Plains]], south of [[Dregan's Pike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the Stronghold was a base used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:S" />

[[File:Stronghold2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Stronghold was patrolled by many different kinds of Imperial troopers.]]
The Stronghold consisted of seven single-story, bunker-like structures, five watch towers, and three landing pads. The majority of the Stronghold was surrounded by a metal wall. It was patrolled and staffed by [[Triumphant-class dark trooper|Triumphant-class]] [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]], [[Non-commissioned officer/Legends|non-commissioned officers]], [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial troopers]], [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], and other specialized stormtroopers, such as [[Imperial medic/Legends|stormtrooper medics]] and [[assault trooper]]s. [[TIE pilot]]s were also present amongst the Stronghold's two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], one [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]], and one [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]]. An Imperial [[Surface Marshal]] staffed the office of one of the Stronghold's buildings.<ref name="SWG:S" />

==History==
{{Quote|Look... the Empire has set up shop a little ways up the road. Let's just say they know of me and won't let me within 1000m of the place. You though can get a good look around there, then one day when I run a story on it, I'll look you up, got it? Here's where you can find it.|An [[Unidentified journalist|excited journalist]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:EJ">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Excited Journalist|Corellia}}</ref>}}
[[File:Stronghold3.jpg|250px|thumb|The Stronghold was staffed by an Imperial Surface Marshal.]]
The base was built and used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The Empire had gone to great lengths to construct this outpost.<ref name="SWG:EJ" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], very few [[Corellia/Legends|Corellians]] knew the exact location of the base and the reason it was constructed. A [[Unidentified journalist|journalist]] from [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] attempted to investigate the stronghold but he was repelled by Imperial authorities. The excited journalist later tried to recruit a spacer to infiltrate the base in order to find out more about its purpose.<ref name="SWG:EJ" /> The former [[Cult of Lord Nyax|Follower of Nyax]] [[Lock Vlash]] was also among the few to known the existence of the base.<ref name="SWG:LV" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Imperial Stronghold had become a contested hotspot in the Galactic Civil War and Imperial and Rebel forces fought several times for the control of the base. Rebel forces managed to capture the base several times but Imperial forces had always taken it back.<ref name="StW" /> Around the same time, a spacer managed to infiltrate the Stronghold and stole [[Scout trooper/Legends|Scout trooper]] [[Scout trooper armor/Legends|armor]] [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="SWG:LISTA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Lost Imperial Scout Trooper Armor}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Stronghold appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:S" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update on [[August 3]], 2003,<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref> the Imperial Stronghold was turned into a "Factional NPC Base". Groups of Rebel players could attack Imperial NPCs and achieve several objectives to take control of the base.<ref name="StW" />
